audit_items.proof_trace: Refund = MAX(0, amount - ceil(debt)) is computed in unsafe_repay_debt_only after interest accrual, then split from the coin via coin.split(residule, ctx) and returned through handle_repay → repay_on_behalf → caller. Move's resource linearity (Coin has no drop ability) guarantees the compiler rejects any code path that drops the refund coin silently. The ceiling rounding is intentional and documented to ensure full debt clearance in fixed-point arithmetic.
